messages:
Ana (Finance): FYI — GCP marketplace usage for reseller 'CloudEdge Solutions' didn't push for Mar 28-30. We see ~120k token-equivalent missing usage. Partner is asking for a credit memo but GCP hasn't issued one yet. Can we do a provisional credit to the partner ledger so they don't get pushed into collection? @Devon (need approval)
Devon (RevOps): Can you paste the delta numbers and which GL to hit? How big is the exposure if we wait for the official credit?
Ana (Finance): Short snapshot below from our reconciler (pseudocsv):
```
reseller,period,reported_usage,expected_usage,delta_usd
CloudEdge,2026-03-28,0,45,1800.00
CloudEdge,2026-03-29,0,50,2000.00
CloudEdge,2026-03-30,0,25,1000.00
TOTAL,,0,120,4800.00
```
We estimate $4,800 to credit. GCP support case created (case 02-893412) but SLA says 5-7 business days. Partner wants something this week.
Priya (Accounting): If we do provisional credit we need a memo and to book to contra-revenue (account 4201) pending reversal when credit memo lands. Also need manager approval for >$2k.
Sam (PartnerOps): Partner contract (SaaS Reseller A1) allows provisional adjustments for marketplace delays if documented. Partner requests we offset against April invoice instead of issuing a separate credit memo — that might be faster. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Devon (RevOps): I'm ok with provisional offset against Apr invoice up to $5k, provided Finance puts a reversing entry and we attach GCP case + partner acknowledgement. Please create a ticket in FIN with reconciliation artifacts. Approve: +1 provisional offset up to $5,000.
Ana (Finance): Creating FIN ticket now and will attach export + partner email. FIN-3197 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-3197. I'll post the partner acknowledgement here once I have it.
Priya (Accounting): Confirming GL: use contra-revenue 4201 and tag with project code 'marketplace-reseller'. Will route for manager sign-off.
Sam (PartnerOps): I'll tell CloudEdge we'll offset on April invoice and send a short confirmation email. They asked for invoice-level detail. Can you include the per-day breakdown above?
Ana (Finance): Will include per-day breakdown and GCP case link in partner email. Draft: "We will offset $4,800 on your April invoice while GCP investigates; we will reverse if/when GCP issues a credit memo." Want me to send from PartnerOps alias or Finance?
Sam (PartnerOps): Send from PartnerOps but CC Finance + RevOps. Thanks. :+1:
gcp-marketplace-bot: Automated report: GCP usage ingestion lag detected for project cloudedge-prod, ingestion_date 2026-03-31. Ticket reference: 02-893412.
Devon (RevOps): One more ask — add a reminder to FIN-3197 for 10 business days to follow up if no GCP credit is received.
Ana (Finance): Done — reminder added. I'll post the partner confirmation when sent.
Sam (PartnerOps): Sent confirmation to CloudEdge, cc'd Finance & RevOps. Quote from their reply: "Appreciate the quick help — offset is fine, please keep us posted on the GCP credit."
Ana (Finance): Posting the partner ack and closing loop here. Will reverse entry if/when GCP issues memo. Thread closed for now. :white_check_mark:
